ModMetaData.name: Flavor Text Extended - Français - Pickle tests (RimBabel)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Development only, never published. Steps of this repository that drive RimBabel (translate an installed mod with the LibreTranslate engine of a local server and copy the package out). Kept in a mod of its own, staged only by wsl-deps.babel.map, because its assembly binds to RimBabel.dll and would fail to load in every pass that does not stage RimBabel.
